Game Overview

At its heart, Serpento is a snake game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Playing Serpento comes down to a simple loop. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Serpento?

Serpento is a free snake game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Serpento free to play?

Yes, Serpento is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
